inputs.question: KGP、HippoRAG 与 ToG-2 各自强调了一类常规检索难以处理的问题场景：请分别说明 KGP 如何区分文档结构类与内容类问题、HippoRAG 定义的 "path-finding multi-hop" 问题难在哪里，以及 ToG-2 的 Both-enhanced 与 Doc-enhanced 案例如何体现图与文档的协作。

outputs.expected_answer: KGP 先由 LLM 判别结构类（提取 Page/Table 关键词直取结构节点）或内容类（TF-IDF 种子段落 + 微调代理遍历邻居）；HippoRAG 的 path-finding multi-hop 难在多条候选路径并存时需锁定连接多个实体的特定路径，简单迭代易迷失；ToG-2 的 Both-enhanced 同时靠三元组推导中间实体并用其文档定位答案，Doc-enhanced 则以三元组引导并从目标实体文档提取最终答案。

source_references.answer_point: KGP 先由 LLM 分类问题关注文档结构还是内容：结构类提取 Page/Table 等关键词直接检索结构节点；内容类以 TF-IDF 初始化种子段落后由微调遍历代理迭代扩展邻居。
source_references.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering

source_references.answer_point: HippoRAG 指出 path-finding multi-hop 问题在多个候选路径并存时需要找到连接多个实体的特定关联路径，简单迭代检索容易因分支过多而迷失。
source_references.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models

source_references.answer_point: ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 案例中区分 Both-enhanced（三元组链接推导中间实体 + 该实体文档上下文确认答案）与 Doc-enhanced（三元组链接引导，最终从目标实体文档上下文找到答案）。
source_references.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval

source_evidence.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/209_Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering.pdf
source_evidence.text:
Here we present the algorithm for our proposed KGP
method for MD-QA. Given a question, we first apply LLM
to classify whether the question is asking about the docu-
ment structure or content. If the question focuses on the doc-
ument structure, we extract the structural keywords such as
Page or Table, and retrieve the content in the correspond-
ing structural nodes in KG. If the question focuses on the
document content, we follow the step according to Algo-
rithm 1. Specifically, we first initialize seeding passages Vs
and the reasoning path queue P by TF-IDF search. Then
for each seeding passage vi ∈Vs, we add its neighbor-
ing passage nodes Ni into the candidate neighbor queue C
(lines 1-4). After that, we iteratively dequeue the earliest en-
queued reasoning path/candidate neighborhood Pi/Ci from
P/C and employ the fine-tuned LLM-based graph traver-
sal agent to rank the dequeued neighbors in Ci by Eq. (1)
(lines 5-7). Last, we select top-k passage nodes V′
i from Ci to
visit next based on their rank and correspondingly update the
candidate neighbor queue and reasoning path queue (lines 8-
13). The above process terminates when either the candidate
neighbor queue becomes empty or the prefixed budget K for
the retrieved passages is met. The time and space complexity
are thoroughly analyzed in Section 8.3 in Supplementary.
5

source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/035_HippoRAG Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models.pdf
source_evidence.text:
3. Lisa Giocomo
8

5.3
HippoRAG’s Potential: Path-Finding Multi-Hop Retrieval
The second example in Table 7, also present in Figure 1, shows a type of questions that is trivial
for informed humans but out of reach for current retrievers without further training. This type of
questions, which we call path-finding multi-hop questions, requires identifying one path between a
set of entities when many paths exist to explore instead of following a specific path, as in standard
multi-hop questions.5
More specifically, a simple iterative process can retrieve the appropriate passages for the first
question by following the one path set by Alhandra’s one place of birth, as seen by IRCoT’s perfect
performance. However, an iterative process would struggle to answer the second question given
the many possible paths to explore—either through professors at Stanford University or professors
working on the neuroscience of Alzheimer’s. It is only by associating disparate information about
Thomas Südhof that someone who knows about this professor would be able to answer this question
easily. As seen in Table 7, both ColBERTv2 and IRCoT fail to extract the necessary passages since
they cannot access these associations. On the other hand, HippoRAG leverages its web of associations
in its hippocampal index and graph search algorithm to determine that Professor Thomas is relevant
to this query and retrieves his passages appropriately. More examples of these path-finding multi-hop
questions can be found in our case study in Appendix E.
6

source_evidence.section: 8. Even though ToG-2 integrates additional knowl-
source_evidence.text:
We demonstrate two cases in AdvHotpotQA to show examples of Both-enhanced Answer and Doc-
enhanced Answer. In the Both-enhanced case, the method not only derives that “the group of Black
Indians associated with the Seminole people is Black Seminoles” from the triple links information,
but also leverages the context within the document of Black Seminoles to determine their settlement
location. In the Doc-enhanced case, the approach utilizes triple links as guidance, ultimately iden-
tifying the target information from the document context of Billy Corgan, a member of the band in
the album. More cases in AdvHotpotQA and ToG-FinQA are shown in Appendix D.
Figure 5: Illustrations of Both-enhanced Answer (left side) and Doc-enhanced Answer (right side).
We also compare the outputs of ToG-2 and CoT regarding the selected questions. As shown in
Appendix B.1 Table 5, ToG-2 alleviates the hallucination issues of LLMs compared to CoT with
in-depth knowledge retrieval, and tends to refuse answers more often when faced with insufficient
knowledge. We also observe a significant number of false negatives in the responses of ToG-2 when
using EM as an evaluation metric, suggesting there is still untapped potential for our method.
5

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对方法归属、实体角色、实验设置与方向；未见题集须独立人工/代理语义判读。
relation_review.uncertainty: 反例题必须直接纠正错误前提或拒答越界实体，不得迎合题干伪前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
